name: Use Skill
description: Load a skill body or a support file from its package.

function.name: use_skill
function.description: Load a skill's instructions by id. Optional file loads a package support doc (references/, templates/, scripts/, assets/) relative to the skill root — prefer this over read_file for absolute skill paths outside the workplace.

file.description: Optional relative path inside the skill package, e.g. references/structure.md or SKILL.md.
